CSS 555

Evaluating Software Design
Winter 2027 · days, time and room TBD · Dr. Marcel Gavriliudraft
📜Syllabus🗓️Schedule📚Course textsoon🧪Projectsoon🔬Labssoon🐳Setupsoon

How to tell whether a software design is good, with evidence: performance, scalability, maintainability, usability and security, each predicted from the design and then measured on the running system or its history.
